results.classification: explicit independent regression rerun, not blind new-case testing

results.detail: All required and whitespace-only configuration failures returned exit 2; no store created.
Missing, empty, unstructured and incomplete provenance all refused before state creation.
Three scopes at the same root hold disjoint records; a fourth sees none.

results.test: tentative versus verified and identity protection
results.detail: Default listing returns verified records, tentative suggestions stay separate, identity injection is discarded and tentative correction leaves verified bytes intact.
Two successive corrections preserve all three rows and bidirectional links; duplicate and unknown corrections refused without changes.

results.test: invalid JSON refusal without data loss
results.detail: Invalid incoming JSON preserves current and previous copies; corrupt stored JSON refuses reads/writes and preserves exact damaged bytes.
Wrong-scope current envelope and previous copy both refused; no mutation or recovery archive produced.
Recovery requires confirmation, restores validated previous snapshot, preserves damaged bytes in a mode-0600 archive, and visibly rolls back the latest addition.
Writes and recovery refuse a preexisting lock, leave lock and state intact; snapshot reader continues to work as documented.
Traversal-like IDs, slash-colliding pairs, Unicode and composed/decomposed Unicode remain distinct hashed scope names in the chosen root.

results.test: blank original templates and optional core tools

detail.core: Explicitly requires no service, connector, model or proprietary library; memory optional. No hardcoded private user paths or installed-memory lookup.

helper_assessment.independent_reexecution: 13/13 groups and missing-primary pass under work/astra-critic; originals unchanged
helper_assessment.assessment: Observed claims are supported by scripts, process exit/stdout/stderr records and current implementation; independently reproduced. Lock contention is explicitly refused rather than queued. No lost acknowledged successful writes in observed concurrent tests. Missing-primary guard preserves previous copy and requires explicit confirmed recovery; rollback does not recreate unavailable newer data.
limitations: Regression evidence, not blind new-case testing.
Evidence fields and user-selected verified status are structurally validated; truth or external source integrity is not authenticated.
SHA-256 maps scope IDs to filenames; it is not a content checksum or tamper-proof store. Recovery checks schema/scope/history and trusts the selected previous snapshot.
No proof of distributed/network filesystem correctness, encryption, hostile filesystem resistance or exhaustive crash/power-loss durability.
Exact Unicode identifiers and trailing whitespace remain distinct scopes.
